# Onboarding imagery

The redesigned app keeps the original Karryam logo geometry and the existing merchant portrait. The logo asset already has transparency; its navy container was removed in Flutter. The first onboarding header shows only the original monogram through a clip; later onboarding and auth headers use no logo.

Two custom photographs were generated with the built-in image_gen tool and saved in the project. They replace the city/brand-bag pictures in the current onboarding composition. Original assets remain available for reference.

## Food

Saved asset: `../assets/onboarding/food-editorial.png`.

Final prompt:

> Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: square editorial photograph for the Karryam vendor mobile onboarding, clipped into rounded cards and circular crops. Create an exceptionally appetising close-up photograph of Nigerian jollof rice, beautifully chargrilled chicken and golden fried plantain, plated in a deep muted teal ceramic bowl on a warm ivory tabletop. Fresh textures, visible rice grains, a small fresh garnish, natural warm daylight, restrained premium restaurant styling. Three-quarter camera angle, tight central composition filling the square, gentle background blur, realistic food photography, sophisticated modern feel. Palette burnt orange food, fresh green, ivory and muted teal. Absolutely no text, letters, logos, branded packaging, shopping bags, city skylines, people, watermarks, or interface elements. Output a single square photograph.

## Shop

Saved asset: `../assets/onboarding/shop-editorial.png`.

Final prompt:

> Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: square editorial photograph for Karryam vendor mobile onboarding, clipped into rounded product cards. Create a beautiful close-up editorial product photograph of a small muted teal market crate filled with fresh tomatoes, vibrant red and yellow peppers, citrus oranges, leafy greens and a plain kraft paper grocery bag. Warm ivory studio backdrop and tabletop, natural daylight, believable produce texture, a few carefully placed fruits outside the crate, inviting premium local shop aesthetic. Three-quarter camera angle, tight central composition filling the square, restrained sophisticated styling, palette teal, fresh greens and warm fruit colours. Absolutely no text, letters, logos, brand marks, printed labels, city skylines, people, watermarks, or interface elements. Output a single square photograph.
